limitations: 16-frame excerpts do not establish long-duration stability
temporal_residual_l1 is unwarped; optional flow_* metrics use estimated reference motion and visibility
raw sources were excluded by identity from documented training inputs; legacy bank provenance is incomplete
spatial metrics use a deterministic frame subset; temporal metrics use every consecutive frame

crowd_run-h264-350000.estimator: OpenCV DIS PRESET_MEDIUM, reference frames only
crowd_run-h264-350000.visibility: in bounds; forward/backward squared disagreement <=0.01*flow energy+0.5; reference warp difference <32/255
crowd_run-h264-350000.aggregation: equal mean of valid frame-pair means; coverage reported separately
crowd_run-h264-350000.limitation: estimated flow and occlusion; low coverage or high reference warp error weakens evidence
